title: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A clear, golden pot for sick days and snow days.
ingredients: 1½ pounds bone-in chicken thighs, skin removed

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Heat the oil in a soup pot over medium. Cook the onion, carrots, and celery until tender, about 8 minutes. Stir in the garlic.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the stock, chicken, thyme, and bay. Bring to a boil, then simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F and pulls apart, about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Lift out the chicken, shred the meat, and discard the bones, thyme, and bay.

steps.title: Add the noodles
steps.text: Boil the noodles in the broth until tender. Return the chicken, stir in the parsley, and season.

notes.Notes: The noodles drink up broth as they sit. Cook them separately if you plan on leftovers.
